MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "None of these items fits a need I would act on now. My nails, screws, and anchors point toward fastening and repair tasks, while the printer supplies require a printing activity I have not shown.",
    "Wood-filled filament does not serve the same purpose as wood screws; the material connection does not make it useful for my construction work.",
    "The cutting wheels and T-post caps have some connection to practical projects, but I have not shown a metal-cutting task, compatible grinder, or T-post fencing need.",
    "My small graduated medicine cups do not imply that I need large syringes with long transfer tubes; measuring small quantities and transferring larger volumes are different tasks.",
    "The magnets and charging cable could be useful in other circumstances, but neither addresses a current need supported by my recent interactions."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "My interest in repair supplies seems to have been stretched into an interest in almost any workshop or DIY item.",
    "The word wood seems to connect my construction screws with printing filament even though they accomplish different jobs.",
    "Several recommendations assume that I use a 3D printer, although nothing in my recent purchases establishes that."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "My repeated interest in framing nails, wood screws, and drywall anchors makes fastening supplies a much stronger clue than a broad connection to making things.",
    "Compatibility matters: nail angle, size, and collation, screw dimensions, and replacement-bag fit are concrete details in my history that affect whether an item is useful.",
    "My vacuum bags and measuring cups reflect separate practical needs; they do not establish an ongoing interest in every cleaning or liquid-handling accessory.",
    "I choose items when they fit a specific task, so a loosely related tool or supply is not enough to make me interested right now."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "My practical repair purchases were interpreted too broadly, overlooking the specific tasks and equipment fit that would make a recommendation useful to me."
}
